page.overview:
Who is Kotal K'etz?

Kotal K'etz is the father of Kotal Kahn and the former ruler of the Realm of Osh-Tekk.

Kotal K'etz was the Emperor of the Realm of Osh-Tekk and father to Kotal Kahn. After Shao Kahn appeared in Osh-Tekk and slaughtered its warriors with the aid of the Shokan Prince, Goro, Kotal K'etz surrendered to save his people, and Osh-Tekk was merged into Outworld.

Kotal K'etz, like all Osh-Tekk, has teal skin and white, pupiless eyes. K'etz has a tall, heavy physique and like his son, Kotal Kahn, K'etz bears Osh-Tekk armor, tribal markings, and clothing comparable to that of the Aztec and Mayan cultures.

Kotal K'etz was once emperor to the realm of Osh-Tekk, home to prosperous and robust race of warriors. After years of conquering all who opposed them, the Osh-Tekk began to forget the true meaning of defeat. All of this changed when their realm was invaded by the Emperor of Outworld, Shao Kahn, and his renowned champion Goro. After a long, one-sided battle, Kotal K'etz swore allegiance to Shao Kahn in exchange for sparing the Osh-Tekk warriors that were so easily defeated. Shao Kahn agrees to show mercy to the inhabitants of Osh-Tekk and departs, allowing K'etz to keep his realm's sacred treasure, the Portal Stone.
